Data Storage

Data persistence module for storing tagged images and detection logs.

Data Storage Module.

This module handles persistent storage of detection data, including: - Saving frames with high-relevance objects (tagged with GPS and timestamp) - Logging detection events to JSONL files - Loading and caching UI assets (icons, images)

GPS coordinates are embedded in image EXIF data, and detection logs are stored in line-delimited JSON format for efficient streaming and analysis.

store.to_deg(value, loc)[source]

Convert decimal GPS coordinates to degrees/minutes/seconds format.

Parameters:

  • value (float) – GPS coordinate in decimal degrees.

  • loc (list[str]) – Two-element list of hemisphere indicators (e.g., [“S”, “N”] for latitude or [“W”, “E”] for longitude).

Returns:

(degrees, minutes, seconds, hemisphere) where:

  • degrees (int): Whole degrees

  • minutes (int): Whole minutes

  • seconds (float): Decimal seconds

  • hemisphere (str): Hemisphere indicator from loc parameter

Return type:

tuple

async store.tag_and_store(image)[source]

Tag image with GPS/timestamp and save to storage.

Embeds GPS coordinates and timestamp in image EXIF data, then saves the image to the tagged folder with a timestamped filename.

Parameters:

image (PIL.Image.Image) – Image to tag and store.

Returns:

Path to the saved image file.

Return type:

str

async store.get_gps()[source]

Get current GPS coordinates.

Retrieves GPS location from the camera module.

Returns:

GPS coordinates as (latitude, longitude).

Falls back to (0, 0) if unavailable.

Return type:

tuple[float, float]

async store.store_image(image, img_exif)[source]

Save image with EXIF metadata to disk.

Parameters:

  • image (PIL.Image.Image) – Image to save.

  • img_exif (dict) – EXIF metadata dictionary.

Returns:

Path to the saved image file.

Return type:

str

store.new_log(initial_data)[source]

Create a new JSONL log file and write initial data.

Parameters:

initial_data (dict) – Initial log entry to write.

store.create_new_element(new_frame_data, frame_num)[source]

Create a formatted log entry for a frame’s detections.

Removes internal-only fields and adds detection numbering and timestamp.

Parameters:

  • new_frame_data (list[dict]) – List of detection dictionaries.

  • frame_num (int) – Frame number.

Returns:

Formatted log entry with frame_num, timestamp, and detections.

Return type:

dict

store.update_log(new_frame_data, frame_num)[source]

Append detection data to the current log file.

Parameters:

  • new_frame_data (list[dict]) – List of detection dictionaries.

  • frame_num (int) – Frame number.

store.save_and_close_log()[source]

Close the current log file and save to disk.

store.get_image(path)[source]

Load an image from disk using OpenCV.

Parameters:

path (str) – Path to the image file.

Returns:

Loaded image with all channels, or None if failed.

Return type:

numpy.ndarray

store.get_grabber_indicator(indicator)[source]

Get cached UI indicator icon.

Loads and caches checkmark/cross icons for bin gripper alignment display.

Parameters:

indicator (str) – Indicator type - “check” or “cross”.

Returns:

Icon image with alpha channel, or None if invalid type.

Return type:

numpy.ndarray or None
